faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Indore Project Associate – I (PA-I) position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Associate – I (PA-I) position at IIT Indore is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree in Physics, Applied Physics, Theoretical Physics, Quantum Information, Optics, Photonics, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related discipline. Alternatively, a B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech. in Engineering Physics, Computer Science, Electrical & Electronics, or Electronics & Communication is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any preference for candidates with GATE or NET scores?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a valid GATE score or CSIR-UGC NET (including LS) or those selected through national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Agencies will be given preference.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Associate – I (PA-I) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Women candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 37,000/- to Rs. 42,000/- per month, plus 20% HRA. The total monthly emoluments can go up to Rs. 50,400/-.

faq.question: Q6. How should I apply for the Project Associate – I (PA-I) recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. You need to send a detailed CV and self-attested copies of relevant documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required for the application?
faq.answer: Required documents include degree certificates, mark sheets, GATE/CSIR-UGC NET score card (if applicable), date of birth proof, and experience certificates. All should be merged into a single PDF.

faq.question: Q8. What is the subject line for the application email?
faq.answer: The subject line for the email should be: "Application for PA-I Position under ANRF-ECRG Project".

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an interview, which may be conducted in an online or hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
